name: Scry
author: Erin Carter
description: A tall, arch-topped obsidian mirror traced by a hairline of palette-tinted edge light, standing slightly off-centre on a near-black ground. Slow domain-warped smoke turns inside it in grey-violet, denser toward the base of the arch; at long intervals thin bright threads of almost-imagery rise toward the glass, sharpen to the edge of legibility, then sink back.

params.label: Swirl speed
params.effect: Angular and warp speed of the interior smoke; min is barely-perceptible creep, max a visible slow stir.

params.label: Mirror height
params.effect: Height of the arched mirror in CSS pixels, trading dark margin for scrying glass; the arch keeps its proportions as it scales.

params.label: Vision rate
params.effect: How often bright threads surface and how near legibility they get; 0 yields pure smoke with no visions, 1 keeps some thread almost always forming.
